summary: The candidate is accurate test-only hardening for an issue-specific production fix already present on the recorded base. It verifies that Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6 wrapper draft configuration exposes one MTP layer through hf_text_config, preventing the EAGLE profiler's erroneous 64-layer fallback and exact 5x KV cell-size inflation.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate commit, all 14 model-config and EAGLE pool tests passed, including the candidate's wrapper, non-draft, and exact cell-size regressions. Raw output: candidate-tests.log

tests.command: same interpreter, issue-specific wrapper regression after temporarily removing only hf_text_config.num_nextn_predict_layers = 1
tests.what_was_measured: Controlled failing-before evidence: the nested draft depth was absent and the candidate regression failed. The production line was restored before leaving the candidate checkout. Raw output: failing-before.log

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-dcd96bdda5d8/venv/bin/python - (independent architecture and stale-value boundary script)
tests.what_was_measured: Dense/MoE conditional and causal-LM Qwen3.5 variants plus InternS2Preview all overwrote stale depth 64 with depth 1; reported geometry computed 34,816 corrected versus 163,840 broken bytes/token. Raw output: adversarial.log

gpu_execution_evidence: The available GPU was inventoried as AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950. Tests exercised deterministic configuration and allocator arithmetic on CPU; they did not execute model kernels on GPU. See gpu-inventory.log.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell/CUDA execution was possible on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950/ROCm 7.2 system.
The unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 weights were unavailable, so the original full-model serving command and direct VRAM recovery were not reproduced.
The prepared recorded base already contains the production correction, so failing-before evidence required a controlled one-line reversion rather than an unmodified-base failure.
A distinct draft embed/lm_head pre-profile lifetime issue may account for smaller residual idle memory, but it does not counterexample the original exact 5x layer-count defect reviewed here.
No native code changed in the candidate; native rebuild and native import-path validation were not applicable. Python imports resolved from /job/repo/python through the prepared interpreter.
